Responsible Gaming

Bingo is meant to be entertainment. Please play within your means and never spend money you need for essential expenses.

Age restriction

You must be at least 18 years old (the platform's configured minimum age) to register or play. Accounts found to belong to underage users will be closed and any deposits refunded where legally required.

Staying in control

  • Set a personal budget before you start playing and stick to it.
  • Never chase losses.
  • Take regular breaks.
  • Contact support if you want help limiting or pausing your account.

Getting help

If gambling is affecting your life negatively, please seek help. Contact our support team to discuss self-exclusion or account limits.
